# EXTERNAL REAL WORK — Contract (LOCKED)

## Goal

```text
получить воспроизводимый научный / инженерный результат,
а не доказать полезность Global OS.
```

Value of the answer must exist **independently of Global OS**.

## Missions

| Id | Type | Title |
|----|------|--------|
| **EW1** | Science | Early predictor of escape into long/chaotic transient vs strong baseline |
| **EW2** | OSS | Live open-source incident investigation with unknown root cause |
| **M-EXT3 / GSA** | Comparison | GOS assembled workflow vs strong single agent on pinned external OSS task |

## Required for each mission

- 2–4 competing hypotheses / explanations
- Strong baseline (or null / status-quo explanation)
- Preregistration **before** holdout / before fix claims
- Sealed holdout (EW1) or pre-registered repro protocol (EW2)
- Counterevidence search
- Independent verification path
- Reproducible code/data
- Honest `SUPPORTED` / `REJECTED` / `INCONCLUSIVE` (or for OSS: `ROOT_CAUSE_CONFIRMED` / `REJECTED` / `INCONCLUSIVE`)

## Forbidden

```text
- не менять Global OS ради улучшения результата,
  если нет реального failure case из миссии
- не использовать внутренние Y24/Y25 результаты
  как evidence научной / OSS гипотезы
- не reopen Y19 / Y24 / Y25 для «дожима»
- не строить ImmuneMemory / AdaptiveVerifier слои из метафоры
```

## Success

A mission succeeds when it produces an **honest terminal record** with
reproducible artifacts — including REJECTED/INCONCLUSIVE.

Global OS “winning” is not a success criterion.
